items.title: SoftBank’s billion-dollar loss may have put a cap on AI’s natural gas ambitions
items.summary: SoftBank lost over $3 billion pre-ordering natural gas turbines to power AI data centers. Here's what the loss means to power markets.
items.creator: Tim De Chant

items.title: Phota Labs uses AI to turn everyday photos into professional-looking shots
items.summary: Rather than giving consumers yet another photo-editing tool, Phota Labs aims to use advances in AI to automate the editing process so it’s easier for anyone to turn everyday moments into better photos.
items.creator: Aisha Malik

items.title: Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress
items.summary: Huang, who was ousted as CEO following reports of an alleged affair with a woman suspected of spying for China, agreed to testify Wednesday after several senior lawmakers threatened to subpoena him.
items.creator: Aisha Malik

items.title: Five ways Jensen Huang’s ouster from Nvidia could damage the AI industry
items.summary: Nvidia's ousted CEO Jensen Huang's downfall isn’t just your run-of-the-mill salacious billionaire sex scandal. He was using his influence to push the AI industry in some very specific ways.
items.creator: Julie Bort

items.title: Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang’s successor
items.summary: In a post on Truth Social, President Trump says only one man can take Jensen Huang's place as head of Nvidia: Tim Cook.
items.creator: Sarah Perez
